policy_clauses.title: Auto Policy - Roadside Assistance
policy_clauses.text: Roadside assistance covers towing up to 25 miles, battery jump-starts, and flat tire changes, limited to 3 uses per policy year.

policy_clauses.title: Home Policy - Water Damage
policy_clauses.text: Water damage from sudden and accidental plumbing failures is covered. Gradual leaks or damage from lack of maintenance are excluded.
